prompt: A hunched, slow-breathing artillery beast that keeps to the middle distance. It lobs glowing radioactive mortars that blind whoever they land on, seeds the floor with a frost field that burns cold and roots anything caught in it, and wraps itself in an icy shell when pressed. Patient, methodical, never rushes in.

A thick-shouldered, heavy-footed brute that wants to be in your face. It lunges across the floor with a kinetic charge that pins its target in place, swings a searing ember fan that stuns at point blank, and shrugs off hits behind a frost shell that also knits its wounds. Relentless, close, loud.

A thin, twitchy, long-legged skirmisher that never lets anyone close. It snaps off frost bolts that freeze feet to the floor, blinks away through the void with a shield already up and its ailments shed, and finishes with a red laser beam that strikes the voice out of its target. Nervous, precise, always moving.
